task: Improve the existing desktop-first URL Activity Scanner results experience for technical users reviewing batches of up to 100 URLs. Prioritize information hierarchy, dense readable results, status summaries, keyboard accessibility, contrast, export accessibility and responsive usability while preserving the existing dark technical identity.

references.description: Design for mobile then enhance for larger

selection_method: heuristic text matching; not design or legal approval

This command does not build, modify, install, deploy, or verify an interface.
